headline: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Demat Compliance Status Questioned for Q2 FY27
hook: Micro-cap compliance check for Raghav Productivity
summary: Raghav Productivity Enhancers is being checked regarding the filing of its demat compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Such compliance certificates confirm that shares have been properly dematerialized during the period under depository guidelines. As a micro-cap stock, procedural filings like this have minimal impact on broader market liquidity. Retail investors holding the stock should verify official exchange filings for confirmation.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance check with no immediate impact on share price.

headline: Raghav Productivity shares surge nearly 200% in six months following Rekha Jhunjhunwala's exit
hook: A six-month triple after a key exit
summary: Shares of Raghav Productivity have jumped nearly 200 percent over the past six months despite the notable exit of investor Rekha Jhunjhunwala. The unusual rally in the micro-cap stock has drawn market attention to the company's underlying fundamentals and growth drivers. For Indian retail investors, surges in micro-cap counters following high-profile exits highlight the need to examine underlying business performance rather than relying solely on celebrity investor tracking.
why_it_matters: Micro-cap rallies need fundamental backing beyond celebrity exits.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / late retail buyers risk volatility
